verified: Forbes reported that Xint, a Darpa-backed cybersecurity company, says its AI using GPT 6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna found remote code execution vulnerabilities in Nginx, and Wiz said it independently found the same flaws; Wiz's advisory names CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007 as critical flaws in Nginx itself.
unconfirmed: the full CVE list and severity — Wiz rates two flaws Critical with a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2, while a separate "nginx 2root" advisory says scores are not yet published and describes five Nginx RCE flaws plus a Linux kernel SCTP bug; also unconfirmed are the affected and patched Nginx versions, and how much of the discovery was done autonomously by the models rather than by Xint's researchers.

verified: 据Forbes报道，Xint称其用GPT 6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Luna发现Nginx远程代码执行漏洞，Wiz表示自己独立发现了相同漏洞。Wiz博客列出CVE-2026-123633和CVE-2026-123007，称两者均为Critical、CVSS 4.0评分9.2，缺陷位于NGINX本身。
unconfirmed: 这些漏洞是否确由Xint的AI独立发现、两家公司谁先发现，目前只有公司说法；受影响版本与补丁状态也未明确。来源对范围与评分说法冲突：Wiz给两个CVE评9.2分，GetAstra称“nginx 2root”含五个Nginx RCE及一个Linux内核SCTP漏洞、CVSS尚未公布，nginx2shell还提到CVE-2026-123634等另外三个漏洞。

titles.en: Xint says GPT models found Nginx RCE flaws; Wiz found same bugs
titles.zh: Xint称其AI发现Nginx远程代码执行漏洞，Wiz称独立发现相同漏洞
